intro: Pozzik plans to work indurium into several parts of the racers, which calls for a great deal of raw ore. The ore is to be had at the Uldaman dig in the Badlands, across the sea in Khaz Modan. The gnomes are already getting hold of their own, and Pozzik wants to keep up with them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'd like to integrate indurium into different parts of our racers, but I need large amounts of raw indurium to create these parts.
You can find indurium ore in the Uldaman excavation in the Badlands, across the sea in Khaz Modan.
The gnomes are getting their own supply of it, so it's important we get our own to keep pace with them.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent! I'll get the crew to work right away on the parts we'll need for the next race.
